北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大体感冷，注意保暖别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels chilly with the wind, remember to dress warmly and stay healthy!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪体感微凉，记得添衣，小心着凉呀！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi feels a bit cool, remember to add clothes and stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海气温 6 ℃，体感微凉，出门记得多穿点。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is 6 ℃, feels cool, remember to layer up when going out.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州天气适宜，出门享受这温暖时光吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou weather is pleasant, go out and enjoy the warm time!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳气温舒适，多云天也很适合户外活动哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen has comfortable temperatures, cloudy days are also great for outdoor activities.
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州体感已是 0 ℃，注意防寒，别忘了戴围巾！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou feels like 0 ℃, remember to keep warm, don't forget your scarf!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京体感 3 ℃，多云天凉，记得多添衣保暖哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing feels like 3 ℃, cloudy and cool, remember to layer up to keep warm.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 11 ℃，体感微凉，出门带把伞。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, 11 ℃, feels a bit cool, bring an umbrella when you go out.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天微凉，体感 5 ℃，别忘了加件外套哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast and a bit cool, feels like 5 ℃, don't forget a jacket!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安体感 4 ℃，昼夜温差大，早晚注意保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an feels like 4 ℃, with large day-night temperature differences, keep warm morning and evening.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，气温 11 ℃，体感舒适，湿度有点高。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, 11 ℃, feels comfortable, humidity is a bit high.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨冰天雪地，体感零下 19 ℃，请务必全副武装！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is freezing, feels like -19 ℃, please bundle up thoroughly!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -19℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳天晴，但体感仍是 -12 ℃，出门记得防寒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, but still feels like -12 ℃, remember to keep warm when going out.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，气温 18 ℃，户外活动别错过！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming has great sunshine, 18 ℃, don't miss outdoor activities!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天微凉，体感 9 ℃，记得带伞以防万一哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast and a bit cool, feels like 9 ℃, remember an umbrella just in case.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾，体感 3 ℃，出行注意防护，保暖为上。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has haze, feels like 3 ℃, protect yourself when going out, keep warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天体感 -6 ℃，风大，记得多穿几件衣服。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast, feels like -6 ℃ with strong wind, remember to layer up.
